h1.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump keeps its own figures; Jack (device) is only the picture
h1.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵保留自己的数字，「千斤頂」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 100 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成100 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成40 MPa。柴油120型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成100 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成40 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device). The picture shows Jack (device). Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 100 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Its subject is Hydraulic control pad with valves. Maximum aggregate size is 6 cm and below.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device)。画面是Jack (device)。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成100 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成40 MPa。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油120型混凝土泵的铭牌。液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units).
body.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成100 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成40 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Maximum aggregate size is 6 cm and below. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: On the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 40 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³.
body.zh: 液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。

question.en: What output does the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device).
answer.zh: 理论输送量是100 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 40 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device).
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是40 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device)画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device).
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_(device)画面里印出的数字。
